comments.author: Pertex
comments.content: i think real multiplayer does not make sense in IF but a touch of multiplayer can be a nice feature. I have added a blackboard to my Quest5 game where every player can write a comment and every other player can read it. And I can think of a virtual pub where player can meet and chat.

comments.author: Jose Martinez
comments.content: "I still think there’s something in the idea of multi-player interactive fiction" - sounds like a MUD. There are still quite a lot of active MUDs; the best resource is probably The Mud Connector (http://www.mudconnect.com/).

comments.author: georgek
comments.content:
Muds and IF have significant differences though, not the least of which is the expectation of taking turns in IF. 

I really like the idea of multiplayer IF, and it seems like designing at least partly for people playing at different times in the same game makes sense.
